dedupe_keys.name: queens new york labelled rooftop photovoltaic imagery

description: The Queens photovoltaic-label team publishes boundaries of rooftop solar installations drawn on 2018 orthographic aerial imagery for Queens, New York. The Zenodo release contains a label archive and the source borough imagery archive, with a description of how labels align to images. The deposit is free under CC BY 4.0. These polygons can train or evaluate detection of distributed solar assets before capacity or hazard-exposure simulations; data-global-power-plant-database provides a separate plant-level comparison. Coverage is one city borough and one imagery year. A caveat is that a visible panel outline does not establish installed electrical rating, connection or operating status. Aerial image rights and positional accuracy should be reviewed before redistribution or use outside the published setting. The own metadata and archive names were checked without downloading imagery or testing label geometry. Preparation scripts are separately assessed.
